title: Dashboard refresh-request thread
summary: Source-level thread connecting the proposed POST /places/{id}/refresh mapping to the place-requested publisher, Forecasts consumer and publisher, and both Dashboard consumer views; linked views do not establish execution order or delivery.

process.scope: Dashboard.requestRefresh and its proposed Places.Refresh mapping, linked to the place-requested publisher, Forecasts consumer/publisher, and Dashboard consumer views.
process.trigger: A caller enters the source-declared Dashboard.requestRefresh handler.
outcomes: The declared HTTP and Kafka relationships are retained with related process views; target resolution, network result, scheduling, provider delivery and message delivery are not established here.
